previous.observation: Fresh root actual returned image/full white-black and coil white-black2x compared with original PV guide, old API, latest user structure/turns-only crop and actual R57 hair crop. Correct anatomical LEFT imageRIGHT two-bead anchor stays behind lower ear/bob-nape BELOW eyes; original closed lashes/arc smile/head tilt/low arms/cropped hand/black long sleeves/red bow/white frill-apron-waist-backties/crop and warm peach skin retained. Broad gray opaque front/return folds taper continuously; no gap manufactured by deleting returns, no fixed visible-hole count. Current curl is still more relaxed/longer than compact R57 projection; static continuity not certified by this single return and actual neighboring motion must decide. Latest user wide-turn crop supplied structure only, not forced horizontal axis or temple root. Root static candidate pending fresh Sol, no hidden curl master/dynamic/user acceptance.
